items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Me and him went to the juice joint and had a ball.

ctx.x: I forgot all about it. So man, we're playing the Palace Theatre in Chicago, I come offstage and the doorman said, 'Hey, Sonny, there's a Colonel in the United States Army want to see you.' I say, 'Yeah, me.' Yeah. So I went down there and here's this cat. Now, he's a colonel in the -- I say, 'Man, what's going down, what's wrong with you.' He say, 'Well, man, I was in the Intelligence Department. What the hell, I told you I'd see you.'
Me and him went to the juice joint and had a ball.
How did you learn to speak German?
